notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Kiki-Jiki.
At least nine creatures in your graveyard.
description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to create a token copy of Kraul Foragers with haste.
The token enters gaining you 9 life.
Pay 9 life to Treasonous Ogre to add {R}{R}{R}.
Pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
